label: Shower Block - Predation
description: A new arrival is exposed in the shower block while predatory inmates test boundaries.
text:
Steam clung to the shower room in greasy sheets, turning the overhead light into a blur and the women beneath it into half-seen shapes of scar tissue, damp skin, and ward-issued fabric stripped away by routine. The floor was slick. The drains stank. Somewhere beyond the tile, a guard's voice barked at someone to keep moving, but inside the room the sound felt distant enough to be useless. Everyone in Arkham knew the showers were a blind spot. That was part of the point.

By the time you stepped under the spray, the room had already noticed you. New arrival. Fresh body. Fresh fear. Fresh uncertainty. The kind of thing some people in this ward treated like an invitation.

Harley Quinn peeled herself up from a bench with a grin too bright for the room, pigtails damp and eyes glittering with instant interest. Poison Ivy moved more slowly at her flank, all cool appraisal and territorial calm, like she had every confidence the space would rearrange itself around whatever she decided to touch.

"Well, lookit this," Harley chirped, stalking closer through the steam. "Fresh meat. Ain't that a sweet little surprise?"
